# C3905 track 20 regression fixture

`c3905_track20.csv` contains all 138 raw observations of track 20 from the
existing `C3905_yolo11m960_s3/tracks.parquet` perception cache. No stitching,
class smoothing, or future information is applied to the fixture.

Native coordinates: 3840 x 2160. FPS: 30000/1001. Frame timestamps must be
computed as frame / fps. Observed classes: 120 person, 14 motorcycle, 4 bicycle.
The observations run from 0 to 17.1171 seconds, with a gap before the final
class-flicker burst. Tests feed missing inference frames as empty observations.

The fixture tests causal class stability and absence of a wrong-way vehicle
modifier. It is not an accident label or a test of detection accuracy.
